description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt/LEDE project for platform-specific hardware checks, upgrades, and configurations related to various embedded devices such as routers. It contains functions to verify image compatibility, perform upgrades, and copy configurations based on the device's board name parameter.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided firmware image is compatible with the device's board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade procedures based on the board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration settings based on the board.
